title: 第723章 会动的铁房子第722章 夫妻去各族创业
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 他们这辆车，是一辆新能源大型挂车改出来的移动餐车。
前半段能住人，是房车配置，
后半段展开后就是厨房，灶台、冷柜、烤箱、油烟净化器、净水箱、售卖窗口一应俱全。
为了买它，夫妻俩几乎掏空积蓄，又申请了政府的泰拉创业专项扶持贷款。
在末日之前，这小两口一个厨师，做江西小炒的，一个则是做烘焙，夫妻店开起来并不难。
可地下城寸土寸金，商铺租金高得吓人，摆摊又会影响空气循环和环境管理，他们这点手艺一直没地方施展。
直到泰拉大陆对大夏百姓彻底开放。
只要签证、备案和经营许可审核通过，大夏人不再只能待在大夏封地，而是可以进入各族城邦旅游、做生意、开店创业。
王强一看到新闻，就知道机会来了。
此刻李雯看着平板上的资料，还在认真分析道：
“半兽人族那边先排除吧，他们整体收入低比较穷，看传送门规格相比起另外几个那么小就知道。”
王强看了眼小了几倍的传送门，赞同点头。
他不是看不起半兽人，而是他们刚起步，赔不起。
创业第一站，必须去消费力更稳的地方。
李雯又说道：
“精灵族也不错，他们喜欢水果、花蜜、菌类，虽然不吃肉，但你可以炒素菜。”
“我的面包、蛋糕等糕点，他们应该也能接受。”
王强回头想起车上的冷柜。
里面冻着猪肉、牛肉、鸡肉、腊肠，还有好几箱预处理好的小炒肉片。
“去精灵那边也不是不行。”
他心疼地嘬了嘬牙花子，
“可这一车肉卖不出去，咱俩晚上就得抱着冷柜哭。”
李雯被他逗笑，又把目光挪到神圣人族那一栏。
王强继续说道：
“所以，我们就选神圣人族吧。”
“他们跟咱们长得差不多，都是人类，饮食习惯再不一样，至少面包、肉、酒都能吃。”
“矮人那边虽然最喜欢酒。”
“咱们也备了啤酒和白酒，但主业不是卖酒，去那边利益最大化不了。”
李雯想了想，果断点头。
“行，那就神圣人族。”
两人很快在车载终端上确认目的地。
前方队伍缓慢移动。
传送门旁，大夏工作人员和神圣人族白袍法师共同维持秩序。
content_en:
Their car is a mobile food truck converted from a large new energy trailer.
The first half can accommodate people, it is an RV configuration.
After the second half is unfolded, there is the kitchen, complete with stove, freezer, oven, oil fume purifier, water purification tank, and sales window.
In order to buy it, the couple almost emptied their savings and applied for the government's special support loan for Terra entrepreneurship.
Before the end of the world, one of the couple was a chef, making Jiangxi stir-fries, and the other was baking. It was not difficult for a couple to open a shop.
However, land in underground cities is at a premium, shop rents are prohibitively high, and setting up stalls will affect air circulation and environmental management, so they have no place to display their skills.
Until the continent of Terra is completely opened to the people of Daxia.
As long as the visas, registrations and business licenses are approved, Daxia people can no longer stay in the Daxia fiefdom, but can enter city-states of all ethnic groups to travel, do business, open shops and start businesses.
As soon as Wang Qiang saw the news, he knew the opportunity had come.
At this moment, Li Wen looked at the information on the tablet and was still analyzing it carefully:
"Let's exclude the orcs first. Their overall income is low and relatively poor. You can tell by looking at how small the size of the portal is compared to the others."
Wang Qiang glanced at the portal that was several times smaller and nodded in agreement.
It wasn't that he looked down on the orcs, but they were just starting out and couldn't afford the compensation.
The first stop for starting a business must be somewhere with more stable consumption power.
Li Wen said again:
"The elves are also good. They like fruits, nectar, and fungi. Although they don't eat meat, you can cook vegetarian dishes."
"They should also be able to accept my bread, cakes and other pastries."
Wang Qiang looked back and thought of the refrigerator in the car.
There were frozen pork, beef, chicken, sausages, and several boxes of pre-processed stir-fried meat slices.
"It's not impossible to go to the elves."
He chewed his teeth in distress,
"But this car of meat cannot be sold, so we both have to hold the freezer and cry at night."
Li Wen was amused by him and moved her eyes to the column of the Holy Human Race.
Wang Qiang continued:
"So, let's choose the Holy Human Race."
"They look similar to us. They are all humans. No matter how different their eating habits are, at least they can eat bread, meat, and wine."
"Although the dwarves like wine the most."
"We also have beer and liquor, but our main business is not selling wine, so we can't maximize our profits there."
Li Wen thought for a while and nodded decisively.
"Okay, then it's the Holy Human Race."
The two quickly confirmed their destination on the car terminal.
The front team moved slowly.
Beside the portal, Daxia staff and the white-robed mage from the Holy Human race worked together to maintain order.
title_en: Chapter 723: The Moving Iron House Chapter 722: The Couple Goes to Start a Business of Various Races
